Reliable, Trustworthy and Respected.

Rilex Networks LLC. is at the forefront of Information Technology and Security Systems, delivering innovative solutions tailored to modern business needs. We bring the same values to every project we've held since day one.

What Separates Rilex Networks From the Rest

Dedicated to Performance and Security

Since 2025, Rilex Networks LLC. has proven the ability to remain on the forefront of the Information Technology and Security Systems field and has provided our customers with the infrastructure necessary to stay up to speed. Rilex Networks prides ourselves on our professional approach, focusing on building long-term relationships with our customers by being reliable, efficient, and experienced.

Regarded as one of the top contracting firms in IT Infrastructure and Security.

We open a clear line of communication between all parties to make sure we address our customers' needs. These are the values we have held for over 40 years and still bring to our projects today.

Industry Compliance
Rilex Networks complies with industry accepted standards including the Telecommunications Industry Association (TIA), Building Industry Consulting Service International (BICSI), and OSHA Safety Guidelines.

Standards and Certification

Licensed, Certified and Insured

Every installation is held to the same standard, regardless of size or scope. We bring certified engineers and technicians to each installation who generate full test reports using professional-grade network equipment. No shortcuts. No guesswork. Every run is documented and verified before we leave the job site.

We unconditionally guarantee all materials and workmanship are free from defects. If it goes in under Rilex Networks, it goes in right — and it stays right.

Our Core Values

What We Bring to Every Project

R

Reliable

Consistency and quality of our work are paramount to our success and longevity. Our clients depend on us for their own success, and we value these relationships built through common goals where trust is essential.

We pride ourselves in working in a well-organized manner with clear, concise communication that maximizes production for our customers and minimizes the effort our clients must exert to reach their desired functionality, budgetary goals, and schedule for completion.

Experienced

There is no substitute for experience. Having been involved in thousands of projects over more than 40 years gives Rilex Networks the edge in knowledge and skill only acquired through time. Through this time, Rilex Networks has developed a process and culture that has been proven successful for decades.

Our Background

The Right Company for the Job

If you're looking for a reliable, trustworthy, and efficient Telecommunications and Security Contracting Firm, Rilex Networks is the right company for you. Although we are in the business of installing communications technology, we believe that communication between customer and contractor is essential in reaching the customer's desired results.

Whether it's a small or large commercial project, we want to take the load off your shoulders by providing a complete range of contracting services, including security integration and camera systems. Just get in touch and let us know what you need, and we'll help you every step of the way.
